messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — embeddings-usw genqueue error spike detected (5xx >= 6/min). Paging @sara for triage.
sara (oncall): On it. I see elevated 5xx and queue backlog. will run quick health checks and restart the worker pool if needed.
emily (ops-comm): Thanks. Can someone draft a short status page initial blurb? keep it minimal: impact, region, mitigation in progress. ping for review once posted.
james (infra): I'm pulling worker logs now. genworker-3 shows repeated OOMs and KV cache evictions. restarting pool in 30s.
sara (oncall): restart triggered on genworker-3. applying temporary backpressure to enqueue to slow the buildup.
emily (ops-comm): Draft (for status page / customer notice): "We are investigating elevated error rates for embeddings in US-West. Some requests may return errors (5xx) or experience increased latency. Engineers are working on mitigation; routing fallback is being applied where possible. We will post updates every ~15 minutes. No customer data was accessed." Please review.
james (infra): +1, add that we're routing to nearby regions as a fallback.
legal-bot: Reviewed — wording acceptable. include support@redwood.ai for escalations.
sara (oncall): Error rate dropping on restarted hosts, backlog draining. still watching for regressions.
emily (ops-comm): Publishing initial status now. cc @localizers for EN/FR/DE variants. Posting customer notice to affected customers (segment: embeddings-usw).
emily (ops-comm): Update template for next post: "Update: error rate reduced; partial restoration observed. Remaining impact: degraded throughput for some requests in US-West. Mitigations in place: restarted workers, routing fallback, enqueue backpressure. Next update in 15 minutes."
james (infra): Fallback routing looks stable; most requests succeed from fallback region with ~50ms extra latency. Pushed a small backpressure patch to queue worker.
sara (oncall): Marking current status as degraded (not full outage). Handoff to infra for continued monitoring and postmortem. Will update if any regression.
emily (ops-comm): 15m status published.
emily (ops-comm): 30m draft resolve: "Resolved: service restored to normal in US-West. Root cause: KV cache thrash under memory pressure causing worker OOMs; a worker bug made recovery slow. Mitigation: restarted workers and applied enqueue backpressure; patch queued for next deploy. No customer data accessed. Postmortem forthcoming."
legal-bot: OK to publish resolved notice.
emily (ops-comm): Publishing resolved notice and closing out public updates. Thanks all — will capture timeline and next steps in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
